source_caption:
📺 Just Beyond (2021)

Just Beyond is a supernatural anthology series that explores the mysterious and unexpected experiences of teenagers who discover that the world around them is far stranger than they ever imagined. Inspired by the graphic novels of R.L. Stine, each episode tells a different story involving ghosts, witches, aliens, parallel dimensions, and extraordinary supernatural encounters. From students uncovering disturbing secrets at their schools to young people discovering mysterious powers, the series combines suspense, fantasy, humor, and heartfelt moments. As the characters confront their fears and navigate unusual situations, they learn important lessons about friendship, courage, identity, and growing up. With imaginative storytelling and surprising twists, Just Beyond delivers a collection of entertaining adventures that blend spooky mysteries with meaningful coming-of-age experiences.

🎭 Genre: Fantasy • Horror • Comedy • Mystery

⭐ IMDb: 6.2/10

⏱️ Runtime: Approximately 25–35 minutes per episode • TV-PG

🎥 Creator: Seth Grahame-Smith

📺 Where to Watch: Originally released on Disney+. Currently unavailable on Disney+ in the United States; check digital platforms for availability.

source_details.synopsis: Just Beyond is an American horror comedy anthology television series created by Seth Grahame-Smith for Disney+, based on the Boom! Studios graphic novel series of the same name by R. L. Stine. The series premiered on October 13, 2021, with all 8 episodes. The series was removed from Disney+ on May 26, 2023.
